## Core Competencies & Specializations
- **Test Automation**: Playwright with Python & Pytest, Page Object Model (POM) architecture, cross-browser test suites, data-driven execution, robust locator strategies.
- **API Testing**: Postman collections, Newman CLI automation, REST & GraphQL verification, JSON schema validation, automated test assertion pipelines.
- **Performance & Load Testing**: Apache JMeter load profiling, stress testing, latency and throughput benchmarking.
- **QA Lifecycle & Defect Management**: Manual test design (Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning), Jira defect lifecycle, STLC workflows, smoke & regression testing.
- **CI/CD Quality Gates**: GitHub Actions automated test runners, artifact archiving, and automated build verification testing.
